name: app.scfcontrolsplatform/mcp-server-scf
description: MCP server for the SCF Controls Platform — 83 tools for controls, evidence, risk, and TPRM.

environmentVariables.name: SCF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your SCF Controls Platform API key. Generate in your self-hosted instance at Settings > API Keys. Starts with the scf_ prefix.

environmentVariables.name: SCF_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your self-hosted SCF Controls Platform instance (e.g. http://localhost:8000). Required — the platform is self-hosted; there is no hosted default.
